ambient_events: The wake that isn't there laps at the transom anyway.
Wind off the Basin worries the edge of a folded cashmere throw.
The horizon smudges grey into grey, water into sky, with no seam.
description: The stern lounge: a crescent of low leather seating open to the air, overlooking the black water of Coldwater Basin. Heaters glow amber under the rail. This is where deals are closed and confidences kept, with nothing behind you but the Basin. You can LOOK SOUTH, EAST, or WEST across the water. The foyer lies to the NORTH.
name: Echelon — Stern Lounge
